_doc: Hero sites on a skirmish map (see src/sim/map_sites.gd). Distances in world pixels, times in seconds. Lair tiers 1-3: guard strength, loot, hero marks and XP once every guard is dead (drop tables lair_1..3 in items.json; item level = time-based level + level_bonus). Shrines heal, refill mana and bless the hero and its units nearby, then rest. Merchants sell potions and a small rotating stock of items for marks (the hero's own coin, never the army's gold) to a hero standing by.
